excerpt: Using the NIH stage model, Dimidjian and Segal estimate that only 30% of research using mindfulness-based interventions has moved beyond Stage 1. The article reports that 20% of total research was at Stage 2a, 9% at Stage 2b, and only 1% had been conducted outside research contexts, calling this a woefully inadequate research base for routine clinical practice.
overview: This statistical summary directly supports the claim that the clinical evidence base is immature. It distinguishes intervention development and early efficacy trials from the more demanding evidence needed for regular-world clinical deployment, especially when public institutions are considering broad adoption.
title: NIH Stage Immaturity
